parsed.note_claim: Walmart is not closing its doors (the rumor that Walmart would close and lock stores on Nov. 1, 2025 is false).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In short, Walmart did not announce it planned to close stores and lock their doors on Nov. 1. Walmart spokesperson Joe Pennington told Snopes by phone that the chain will be open for business on that date.
parsed.reason: The fact check directly debunks the claim that Walmart was closing and locking its doors, citing a Walmart spokesperson confirming stores will be open.
